title: MicrosoftFormsAttachmentSchema
description: JSON schema for parsing Microsoft Forms attachment metadata / 用於解析 Microsoft Forms 附件元數據的 JSON 結構描述

name.description: Original file name of the uploaded attachment / 上傳檔案之原始檔案名稱

link.description: OneDrive file access link / OneDrive 檔案存取連結

id.description: Unique file identifier / 檔案唯一識別碼

type.description: File type or extension / 檔案類型或副檔名

size.description: File size in bytes / 檔案大小 (bytes)
